# Eligibility Criteria

This folder defines the inclusion rules for the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). It specifies the exact diagnostic codes and hospital contact thresholds required for a patient to be registered in the national database, covering conditions like Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, short bowel syndrome, and primary sclerosing cholangitis. All criteria are traced back to the official DANIBD annual reports, providing the foundational definitions for the registry's patient population.

## Pages

- [[eligibility-criteria|Eligibility Criteria]] — Details the specific Landspatientregisteret action diagnoses (DK50*, DK51*, DK830F, DK912B) and the minimum two-contact threshold required for patient inclusion in DANIBD.
